name: Meeting
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING
OF THE
CITY COUNCIL AND
REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
TUESDAY - MARCH 26, 2013 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
A G E N D A
Public input will be allowed on all Agenda items at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered.
1.
Call to Order
2.
Invocation
3.
Pledge of Allegiance
4.
Roll Call
5.
Presentations and Appointments
A.
Presentations
B.
Consideration of appointments to Commissions and Committees. (COUNCIL)
C.
Consideration of City Council Committee assignments. (COUNCIL)
6.
Public Comments and Suggestions
CONSENT CALENDAR
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7.
Approval of Registers of Demands
A.
City of Cerritos dated March 26, 2013. (COUNCIL)
B.
Successor Agency dated March 26, 2013. (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
8.
Approval of Minutes
A.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of February 28, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
B.
City Council Special Meeting of March 12, 2013. (COUNCIL)
C.
City Council/Successor Agency Special Meeting of March 13, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
D.
City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting of March 14, 2013. (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY)
End of Consent Calendar
If you would like to speak on any of the remaining Agenda items, please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card. Speakers will be called upon for comment after the report on the item is given by City staff.
9.
Public Hearing Notices
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING THE SUBMITTAL OF A FUNCTIONAL CLASSIFICATION CHANGE TO THE CALIFORNIA DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION FOR GRIDLEY ROAD FROM 195TH STREET TO MAPES AVENUE FROM GRIDLEY ROAD TO DEL AMO BOULEVARD. (COUNCIL)
10.
New and Old Business
A.
Consideration to waive reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS DETERMINING AND DECLARING PRIMA FACIE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN STREETS IN THE CITY OF CERRITOS. (COUNCIL)
11.
Legislative Items
A.
Report on Pending Legislation.
B.
Action to support or oppose specific legislation pending in the State or Federal Legislature or pending in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.
12.
City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.
13.
Adjournment
